notes: Format fixture (mw-e22.3), not shipped: Ottilie Marsh at Marsh's General Store (story bible §5.15), a first meeting and a return from one file. The return entry is chosen by dialogue.visitedCount; the news option is once-only. The real conversation is written under E39.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Mind the step, the bridge stones are slick this time of year. Ottilie Marsh. First shop past the bridge, and the scales are honest, whatever you've heard.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Back again, and in one piece. That's more than I can say for the hinges on my door.

options.text: Seen anyone odd cross the bridge lately?

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Odd? Love, it's a bridge. Though Mags Oakum's barge has gone down the river empty twice this week, and she hates running empty.
